public_rationale: On the ordinary public-evidence reading, Marcus's caution is supported. The contemporaneous announcement presents selected mathematical results from an internal Astra model. The search found no pre-publication evaluation establishing its broader practical reliability. The earlier ARC-AGI-3 disclosure concerned Sol. Later Astra evaluations cannot retroactively establish what readers knew on August 3.
limitations: This does not establish that Astra was incapable of practical work.
The conclusion depends on reading the sentence as a statement about public evidence.
No finite search can exclude every unpublished test or overlooked public disclosure.
